scope.quotaLimit: Logical allowances only, not allocator capacity, whole existing event queue, every allocation, process RSS or strict CPU theorem
scope.failure: Own capture quota/allocation reports failed evidence without changing ordinary format admission; shared reader limits may still fail read; exception leaves unqualified prefix
